GLEIF returns 404 for /direct-parent and /ultimate-parent on a lei-record in this copy of the API, so no ownership-parent edge is drawn from GLEIF at all. Ownership in this graph comes from SEC 13D/13G cover pages only.
中石油 matched to PetroChina Company Limited, the listed subsidiary, not to China National Petroleum Corporation, the parent: GLEIF has no record under the parent's English name.

南大通用 and 协医 have no LEI and the Chinese national credit registry (国家企业信用信息公示系统) exposes no open API, so both are manual records with no registry attributes and no edges. Their legal identities are unverified.
No ownership edge links 南大通用 or 协医 to any Fortune company: no source in this build establishes one, and none was invented.
